name: OpenVibe.Reviews

site.name: Reviews
site.what: Review signals gathered across sources with provenance, pros and cons, and community discussion. No invented ratings.
site.description: OpenVibe.Reviews gathers what people say about products, services, employers, hosts and communities across many sources — with provenance, without fake ratings — and lets the community discuss it.

pillars.title: Where each number came from
pillars.text: Every signal keeps its source, the item it came from, and when it was read.

pillars.title: An aggregate you can check
pillars.text: The inputs and the method are listed; an editor leaves a source out only with the reason shown.

pillars.title: Changes on the record
pillars.text: Replaced and withdrawn signals stay in the history, beside every revision of the aggregate.

pillars.title: Summaries by people
pillars.text: Written or approved by an editor, citing the signals they rest on, and never carrying a rating.

faq.question: Where do the ratings come from?
faq.answer: Every rating shows its source and when it was read: members' own reviews, the ratings members saved from sites like Glassdoor, Yelp or Trustpilot, and signals from permitted sources.

faq.question: Can I write a review?
faq.answer: Yes, as any signed-in OpenVibe member: 1 to 5 stars and how you know the place (an employee, a tenant, a customer). Members' reviews are shown as theirs, never mixed into the sources' aggregate.

faq.question: What are official records?
faq.answer: What a public body published: CFPB complaint counts for companies, NYC Health inspections for restaurants and NYC HPD's open housing violations for apartment buildings, each linked to its source.

faq.question: Does Reviews copy other sites' reviews?
faq.answer: No. /everywhere opens Glassdoor, Yelp, the BBB, Trustpilot, Google Maps and others for a name, each in its own tab; their reviews stay there.

site.keywords: openvibe reviews, review aggregation, honest reviews

meanwhile.label: Talk about it
meanwhile.note: Community threads are the first stop.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

drains: Sources pull and import-queue timers cleared

resumes.what: the OpenVibe.Sources change feed is pulled again from the stored cursor, so items published during the stop arrive (idempotent per item revision)
the import queue drains what was left in it
OpenVibe.Events redelivers sources.item.* that were pending during the stop (at least once, deduped by event_id)
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

leases.none: no claims: one process owns the ov_reviews PostgreSQL database; writes are transactions there

notes: Entities with aliases and typed links; resolution of OpenVibe.Sources review items by deterministic rules (source binding, URL, GTIN/SKU/MPN) with editor confirmation for name-only and conflicting matches; merges that rewrite nothing and splits that restore attribution exactly, both audited; typed signals with provenance (source item, item revision, retrieval time, licence note) and trust metadata; aggregates computed only from signals present (method reviews-aggregate@1, inputs and exclusions exposed, absent without qualifying signals, a new revision on every change); editor-written or AI-drafted-and-approved summaries whose points cite signals and never carry a rating; source removal withdraws signals, flags citing summaries and prepares a pending revision; corrections queue; Community discussion referenced, not copied. Server-rendered pages useful without JavaScript; AggregateRating/Product/Review JSON-LD only when signals back it; sitemaps, feeds and Search index events from the openvibe-publishing v0.2.0 gate. Deployed internally (loopback only), not launched publicly: openvibe.reviews serves the OpenVibe.Sites placeholder until the launch rule holds.
